Strategy: Awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; tight and roomy residuals rank like Best Fit, but residuals between half and full item size score far lower. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that awkward band while a looser bin can still hold another item. It may help by avoiding leftovers too small for a repeat item yet too large to ignore, but may fail if later items are smaller than the current one.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - 200.0 if r - item > item / 2 and r - item <= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Awkward-band avoidance: penalize post-placement residuals in (item/2, item], exact fit highest, else Best Fit.
